preconditions.description: n is an integer between 1 and 1,000,000, inclusive.
m is an integer between 1 and 1,000,000, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output == sum((1 for x in range(1, n+1) for y in range(1, m+1) if (x + y) % 5 == 0))
postconditions.description: The output is the total number of pairs (x, y) such that 1 ≤ x ≤ n, 1 ≤ y ≤ m and (x + y) is divisible by 5.
